verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs or sends is a fair question for an email delivery platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only on-demand send endpoints (single, batch, bulk, template), event webhooks, and inbound processing, with nothing on scheduled or recurring jobs or workflows. Webhooks and the 'sample inbound workflow' are event-driven or one-off, not recurring schedules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
